This topic is part of the AQA GCSE Food Technology specification.

Food Preparation Skills appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Food Preparation Skills in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The AQA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Food Preparation Skills.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
